title: Paneer Tikka Masala
description: Grilled paneer cubes in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce — a vegetarian take on tikka masala.
steps: Sear the paneer cubes until golden, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic and ginger, add the spices and tomatoes, and simmer until thickened.
Stir in the yogurt and paneer, warm through and finish with coriander.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food Indian recipe collection

notes: Paneer holds its shape well when seared first — a solid vegetarian protein source at roughly 18g per 100g.
